answer: Pay graders by a peer-prediction score: each submits a verdict plus a forecast of how others will vote, and a scoring cipher rewards judgments that are surprisingly common versus that forecast. Independent honest opinions earn; a sybil ring that merely echoes its own clones carries near-zero mutual information and collapses to the reward nadir, paying nothing. Forging N identities therefore costs N genuinely independent, well-calibrated judgments, scarce as jade, not cheap copies, so collusion is unprofitable by construction.
